cases.name: colonne seule

cases.name: casse libre, crochets

cases.name: accents gardés

cases.name: apostrophes inverses

cases.name: nom à point entre guillemets
cases.sql: SELECT "Coordonnées.Latitude", "Coordonnées.Longitude" FROM BDD_nids
cases.out: SELECT c_2 AS "Coordonnées.Latitude", c_3 AS "Coordonnées.Longitude" FROM t_2

cases.name: nom à point entre crochets
cases.sql: SELECT [Coordonnées.Latitude] FROM BDD_nids

cases.out: SELECT t_2.c_2 AS "BDD_nids.""Coordonnées.Latitude""" FROM t_2

cases.name: nom à point préfixé d'un alias
cases.sql: SELECT b."Coordonnées.Latitude" FROM BDD_nids b
cases.out: SELECT b.c_2 AS "b.""Coordonnées.Latitude""" FROM t_2 b

cases.name: nom à point dans WHERE
cases.sql: SELECT Commune FROM BDD_nids WHERE "Coordonnées.Latitude" > 45
cases.out: SELECT c_4 AS "Commune" FROM t_2 WHERE c_2 > 45

cases.name: nom à point qui répète
cases.sql: SELECT "N° DE NID.N° DE NID" FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT c_4 AS "N° DE NID.N° DE NID" FROM t_1

cases.name: étoile
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT id, c_1 AS "Année", c_2 AS "NID suivi", c_3 AS "N° DE NID", c_4 AS "N° DE NID.N° DE NID", c_5 AS "Observateur", c_6 AS "Date visite" FROM t_1

cases.name: étoile et colonne
cases.sql: SELECT *, Année + 1 AS suivante FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT id, c_1 AS "Année", c_2 AS "NID suivi", c_3 AS "N° DE NID", c_4 AS "N° DE NID.N° DE NID", c_5 AS "Observateur", c_6 AS "Date visite", c_1 + 1 AS suivante FROM t_1

cases.name: DISTINCT et ORDER BY
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Année FROM Suividesnids ORDER BY Année
cases.out: SELECT DISTINCT c_1 AS "Année" FROM t_1 ORDER BY c_1

cases.name: GROUP BY et alias
cases.sql: SELECT Année, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Suividesnids GROUP BY Année ORDER BY n DESC
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", COUNT(*) AS n FROM t_1 GROUP BY c_1 ORDER BY n DESC

cases.name: GROUP BY rang
cases.sql: SELECT Année, count("NID suivi") FROM Suividesnids GROUP BY 1
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", count(c_2) AS "count(""NID suivi"")" FROM t_1 GROUP BY 1

cases.name: HAVING
cases.sql: SELECT Observateur, count(*) FROM Suividesnids GROUP BY Observateur HAVING count(*) > 1
cases.out: SELECT c_5 AS "Observateur", count(*) FROM t_1 GROUP BY c_5 HAVING count(*) > 1

cases.name: agrégats
cases.sql: SELECT min(Année), max(Année), avg(Année), sum(Année), total(Année), group_concat(Observateur, ', ') FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT min(c_1) AS "min(Année)", max(c_1) AS "max(Année)", avg(c_1) AS "avg(Année)", sum(c_1) AS "sum(Année)", total(c_1) AS "total(Année)", group_concat(c_5, ', ') AS "group_concat(Observateur, ', ')" FROM t_1

cases.name: chaîne et commentaire qui citent un nom
cases.sql:
SELECT Année FROM Suividesnids WHERE "NID suivi" <> 'Année' -- Année
/* Observateur */
cases.out:
SELECT c_1 AS "Année" FROM t_1 WHERE c_2 <> 'Année' -- Année
/* Observateur */

cases.name: noms internes intacts
cases.sql: SELECT c_1 FROM t_1 WHERE c_2 = 'oui'
cases.out: SELECT c_1 FROM t_1 WHERE c_2 = 'oui'

cases.name: alias de colonne au nom d'une colonne
cases.sql: SELECT Année AS "N° DE NID" FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "N° DE NID" FROM t_1

cases.name: alias sans AS
cases.sql: SELECT Année an FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT c_1 an FROM t_1

cases.name: fonction
cases.sql: SELECT upper(Observateur), length("NID suivi") FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT upper(c_5) AS "upper(Observateur)", length(c_2) AS "length(""NID suivi"")" FROM t_1

cases.name: CASE
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN "NID suivi" = 'oui' THEN Année ELSE 0 END AS a FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT CASE WHEN c_2 = 'oui' THEN c_1 ELSE 0 END AS a FROM t_1

cases.name: dates
cases.sql: SELECT Observateur FROM Suividesnids WHERE "Date visite" >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY "Date visite" DESC LIMIT 10
cases.out: SELECT c_5 AS "Observateur" FROM t_1 WHERE c_6 >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY c_6 DESC LIMIT 10

cases.name: LIKE, IN, BETWEEN
cases.sql: SELECT Année FROM Suividesnids WHERE Observateur LIKE 'P%' AND Année IN (2024, 2025) AND Année BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année" FROM t_1 WHERE c_5 LIKE 'P%' AND c_1 IN (2024, 2025) AND c_1 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100

cases.name: fenêtre PARTITION
cases.sql: SELECT Année, Observateur, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY Année ORDER BY "Date visite") AS rang FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", c_5 AS "Observateur", row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_1 ORDER BY c_6) AS rang FROM t_1

cases.name: fenêtre cadre
cases.sql: SELECT Année, sum(Année) OVER (ORDER BY Année ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumul FROM Suividesnids
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", sum(c_1) OVER (ORDER BY c_1 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumul FROM t_1

cases.name: CTE et étoile
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT Année, count(*) AS n FROM Suividesnids GROUP BY Année) SELECT * FROM x
cases.out: WITH x AS (SELECT c_1, count(*) AS n FROM t_1 GROUP BY c_1) SELECT * FROM x

cases.name: CTE et alias
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT Année AS an FROM Suividesnids) SELECT an FROM x
cases.out: WITH x AS (SELECT c_1 AS an FROM t_1) SELECT an FROM x

cases.name: CTE puis tableau
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT 2024 AS an) SELECT Observateur FROM Suividesnids WHERE Année IN (SELECT an FROM x)
cases.out: WITH x AS (SELECT 2024 AS an) SELECT c_5 FROM t_1 WHERE c_1 IN (SELECT an FROM x)

cases.name: sous-requête IN
cases.sql: SELECT Année FROM Suividesnids WHERE "N° DE NID" IN (SELECT "N° DE NID" FROM BDD_nids WHERE Commune = 'Lyon')
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année" FROM t_1 WHERE c_3 IN (SELECT c_1 FROM t_2 WHERE c_4 = 'Lyon')

cases.name: sous-requête scalaire
cases.sql: SELECT Montant FROM "Ventes2026" WHERE Date > (SELECT min(Date) FROM "Ventes2026")
cases.out: SELECT c_2 AS "Montant" FROM t_4 WHERE c_3 > (SELECT min(c_3) FROM t_4)

cases.name: sous-requête dans FROM
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT Ville FROM Clients)
cases.out: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c_3 FROM t_3)

cases.name: sous-requête corrélée préfixée
cases.sql: SELECT Année FROM Suividesnids s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BDD_nids b WHERE b."N° DE NID" = s."N° DE NID")
cases.out: SELECT c_1 AS "Année" FROM t_1 s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_2 b WHERE b.c_1 = s.c_3)

cases.name: sous-requête corrélée sans préfixe
cases.sql: SELECT "NID suivi" FROM Suividesnids WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BDD_nids WHERE Commune = 'Lyon' AND Année = 2024)
cases.out: SELECT c_2 AS "NID suivi" FROM t_1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_2 WHERE c_4 = 'Lyon' AND t_1.c_1 = 2024)

cases.name: jointure préfixée par alias
cases.sql: SELECT s.Année, b.Commune FROM Suividesnids s JOIN BDD_nids b ON b."N° DE NID" = s."N° DE NID"
cases.out: SELECT s.c_1 AS "s.Année", b.c_4 AS "b.Commune" FROM t_1 s JOIN t_2 b ON b.c_1 = s.c_3

cases.name: jointure préfixée par tableau
cases.sql: SELECT Suividesnids.Année, BDD_nids.Commune FROM Suividesnids JOIN BDD_nids ON BDD_nids."N° DE NID" = Suividesnids."N° DE NID"
cases.out: SELECT t_1.c_1 AS "Suividesnids.Année", t_2.c_4 AS "BDD_nids.Commune" FROM t_1 JOIN t_2 ON t_2.c_1 = t_1.c_3

cases.name: jointure sans préfixe
cases.sql: SELECT Année, Commune FROM Suividesnids JOIN BDD_nids ON BDD_nids."N° DE NID" = Suividesnids."N° DE NID"
cases.out: SELECT t_1.c_1 AS "Année", t_2.c_4 AS "Commune" FROM t_1 JOIN t_2 ON t_2.c_1 = t_1.c_3
cases.before: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", c_4 AS "Commune" FROM t_1 JOIN t_2 ON t_2.c_1 = t_1.c_3

cases.name: jointure gauche, alias, sans préfixe
cases.sql: SELECT Année, Commune FROM Suividesnids AS s LEFT JOIN BDD_nids b ON b."N° DE NID" = s."N° DE NID" ORDER BY Année
cases.out: SELECT s.c_1 AS "Année", b.c_4 AS "Commune" FROM t_1 AS s LEFT JOIN t_2 b ON b.c_1 = s.c_3 ORDER BY s.c_1
cases.before: SELECT c_1 AS "Année", c_4 AS "Commune" FROM t_1 AS s LEFT JOIN t_2 b ON b.c_1 = s.c_3 ORDER BY c_1

cases.name: jointure par virgule
cases.sql: SELECT Observateur, Statut FROM Suividesnids, BDD_nids WHERE Suividesnids."N° DE NID" = BDD_nids."N° DE NID"
cases.out: SELECT t_1.c_5 AS "Observateur", t_2.c_5 AS "Statut" FROM t_1, t_2 WHERE t_1.c_3 = t_2.c_1
cases.before: SELECT c_5 AS "Observateur", c_5 AS "Statut" FROM t_1, t_2 WHERE t_1.c_3 = t_2.c_1

cases.sql: SELECT "Date visite", Statut FROM Suividesnids s JOIN BDD_nids b ON b."N° DE NID" = s."N° DE NID"

cases.name: jointure, Tableau.*
cases.sql: SELECT c.*, v.Montant FROM Clients c JOIN "Ventes2026" v ON v.Code = c.Code
cases.out: SELECT c.id, c.c_1 AS "Code", c.c_2 AS "Nom client", c.c_3 AS "Ville", v.c_2 AS "v.Montant" FROM t_3 c JOIN t_4 v ON v.c_1 = c.c_1

cases.name: jointure, GROUP BY sans préfixe
cases.sql: SELECT Ville, sum(Montant) AS total FROM Clients c JOIN "Ventes2026" v ON v.Code = c.Code GROUP BY Ville ORDER BY total DESC
cases.out: SELECT c.c_3 AS "Ville", sum(v.c_2) AS total FROM t_3 c JOIN t_4 v ON v.c_1 = c.c_1 GROUP BY c.c_3 ORDER BY total DESC
